ipv4-cidr-aggregator.name: IPv4 CIDR Aggregator
ipv4-cidr-aggregator.description: Merge overlapping and adjacent IPv4 networks into the smallest exact CIDR list for firewall rules and allowlists.

meta.title: IPv4 CIDR Aggregator
meta.description: Merge overlapping and adjacent IPv4 networks into the smallest exact CIDR list for firewall rules and allowlists.
meta.keywords: IPv4, CIDR aggregation, subnet merge, firewall, allowlist, network summarization

cidrAggregator.hint: One address or CIDR per line; blank lines are ignored. Up to {limit} entries and {inputLimit} UTF-16 code units.
cidrAggregator.normalization: Host bits are cleared: 192.0.2.10/24 means the entire 192.0.2.0/24 network. Bare addresses mean /32. Leading zeros, comments, ranges and IPv6 are not accepted.
cidrAggregator.emptyResult: Enter networks and aggregate them to see the result.
cidrAggregator.rules: The output covers exactly the normalized input networks, without adding addresses between separate ranges. Counts include network, broadcast and reserved addresses; they are not usable-host estimates.
cidrAggregator.empty: Enter at least one IPv4 address or CIDR.
cidrAggregator.inputLimit: Use at most {inputLimit} UTF-16 code units.
cidrAggregator.entryLimit: Use at most {limit} non-empty entries (exceeded at line {line}).
cidrAggregator.invalidAddress: Line {line}: enter four decimal octets from 0 to 255 without leading zeros.
cidrAggregator.invalidPrefix: Line {line}: use a single / followed by an integer prefix from 0 to 32 without leading zeros.
